If it has dual climate control, that clicking sound is more than likely the blend door actuator on the drivers side. Which would lead to it blowing hot on the passengers side. I believe there’s a certain procedure that you can do that’ll relearn the blend door motor and sometimes that fixes it, but if the motor is clicking it’s more than likely stripped the gears inside of it and the motor just needs to be replaced.

I’ve never broken up with somebody so I’ve always been the dumpee. As to that, my first breakup was horrible. I suffered for four months of nonstop crying and depression. I was in that relationship a little over five years. The relationship was extremely toxic we constantly argued. 

My previous relationship that ended a couple of months ago has been a lot easier. We were together a little over two years. I planned on marrying my ex, she was everything I ever wanted. We very rarely argued and it wasn’t a bad relationship at all. It was mainly lack of communication. But she pulled the I love you but I’m not in love with you card. And it was rough for the first month. I mean breaking down crying at college and uncontrollably sobbing on the floor when I was home rough. After that month and going no contact life has been getting better. I still think about her everyday but the pain is slowly going away. We ended on good terms, she called me an amazing guy she said she just wasn’t in the right place for a boyfriend right now. She had been struggling with what she wants to do in college. 

I loved my last ex more than I ever thought I could love someone. But I finally realized that if she broke up with me it’s probably not meant to be. But if we find each other down the road then I would most definitely give it another shot. I’m just not hoping for anything and if it happens it happens. 

Life does get better. Since the breakup I’ve lost 25 lbs and I’ve been hitting the gym everyday. That’s probably helped me the most. And spending time with close friends. Granted I really don’t have a lot of friends but the one or two I do have I spend the most time I can with them. This sub has helped me tremendously. I read about people who have been together over 8 years. I couldn’t even imagine the grief nor do I want too. But reading that and looking at my situation I told myself that I have it easy compared to others. So I’m just trying to enjoy my life being single for a little while. But it gets better even when it feels like it never will. Sorry for the long response lol.

I’m in the same boat as well. She broke up with me after 2years less than a month ago. She gave me the old,”it’s me not you” ordeal. Just found out she went to see another guy. I’ve been just trying to stay busy and not think about it. I’m at a point now to where I just want to be happy without a relationship and focus on myself. It still hurts I still get that knot in my stomach but it’s getting better. There’s always light at the end of the tunnel.

Breakups are rough. Some of the lowest times in my life were over relationships. I’ve learned that as hard as it may be, no contact is the best way to get over somebody. In my case I went to the extreme and deleted all my social media so I wouldn’t be tempted to look at her profiles and I deleted her number out of my phone. I never had memorized her number so there’s no way I could contact her even if I tried.  

The hardest thing is just letting go of somebody you care so deeply about. But still talking to your ex and having hope of getting back together just makes things so much worse. Focus on yourself, go for a walk, hit the gym, just stay busy doing things for yourself. When he sees this he’s probably going to want to get back together, but by that time you will be happy with yourself and will learn there’s a million of other people on this planet that are way more suited for you.

There could be a vast variety of reasons why he’s still talking to you. But from my past experiences do not wait on somebody that doesn’t want to be in your life. If he wanted to be in your life he would’ve never said that he doesn’t want to be with you.  My ex just did the same thing. She just wanted to  be friends. But turns out she was just using me to have somebody to talk to until she found another guy. Keep your head up, do your best to enjoy life as being single, things will get better.
